ValidationRule.description: HU1 PM - RN04 Opportunity: solo el propietario puede cambiar una Opportunity PM a Closed Won o Closed Lost.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Oportunidad_Personas_Morales", NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Closed Lost") ), PRIORVALUE(OwnerId) <> $User.Id, $UserRole.DeveloperName <> "Head_PM" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Solo el propietario puede cerrar la oportunidad.
